newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian president too ill to address nation.
newsitem.headline: Austrian president too ill to address nation.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil is too ill to deliver a televised National Day address on Saturday and will issue a written speech instead, his office said on Wednesday.
Klestil, 63, is recovering from pneumonia in a Vienna hospital. It will be the first time the president, who took office in 1992, has failed to speak on Austria's National Day.

"In order not to jeopardise his (recovery), we have urged the president to spare his vocal chords as far as possible and to avoid the television address," said Stefan Breyer, at the infectious diseases department of Vienna General Hospital.
Klestil was admitted to hospital six weeks ago and spent several days in intensive care hooked up to an artificial respirator.
